Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent electronic face display layer for a product configurator. Input image is an alignment reference for the exact luminous face expression. Create a square PNG the same framing as the 1254 by 1254 reference. Keep ONLY the two white luminous curved happy eyes and small white smiling mouth, at precisely the same original pixel positions, size, perspective, brightness and subtle glow. EVERYTHING ELSE, including robot, black display, highlights, environment, shadows and background must be fully transparent. Do not move, scale or center the eye/mouth cluster independently: keep their positions relative to the full original square canvas. Transparent pixels on all remaining parts of the square. No text, logos, objects or extra marks.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent electronic face display layer for a product configurator. Input image is an alignment reference. Output a square transparent PNG with identical framing to the 1254 by 1254 reference. Keep ONLY a new simple expression in the same exact region of the original face display: two small luminous white round-dot eyes centered where the original curved happy eyes are centered, and one short straight luminous white horizontal mouth centered where the original smiling mouth is centered. Simple is a calm neutral electronic expression, symmetrical but respecting the original display's subtle perspective. Use the same natural illuminated white and slight glow as the reference. EVERYTHING ELSE must be fully transparent: robot, black display, reflections, environment and shadows removed entirely. Do not move or scale the expression cluster relative to the full original square image. No text, logos, extra marks or shapes.
